findings.evidence: grep '^namespace' over EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/**: every file mirrors its directory in its namespace (e.g. Exclusive/DVCS/Basic.lean -> DIS.Exclusive.DVCS, PVES/Electroweak/Parameters.lean -> DIS.PVES.Electroweak); Diffractive/Basic.lean is the sole exception. grep 'namespace ExclKinematics' matches only Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:48 and Diffractive/Basic.lean:55.
findings.fix: Keep the file where it is (roadmap README:96) and declare its contents under a namespace matching the path, e.g. `namespace DIS` / `namespace Diffractive`, with the variables taking `(K : ExclKinematics V)` as an explicit argument (`Diffractive.xi g K`, `Diffractive.beta g K`, `Diffractive.MX2 g K`, `Diffractive.xBj_eq_xi_mul_beta`). This is also what the PR description itself claims ("the diffractive variables live in `namespace Diffractive` on `ExclKinematics V`"), contradicting the code.
findings.issue: Module path is `...DIS.Diffractive` but the namespace stack is `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Scattering.DIS.Exclusive.Kinematics.ExclKinematics` (lines 49-55), so `xi`, `xi_def`, `beta`, `beta_def`, `MX2`, `MX2_def`, `MX2_eq_q_sub_delta` and `xBj_eq_xi_mul_beta` land in the exclusive-kinematics API while living under `Diffractive/`. The `ExclKinematics` namespace is split across two unrelated directories, and the diffractive `ExclKinematics.xi` becomes a sibling of the exclusive skewness `ExclKinematics.xiSkew` (Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:66) — two different momentum fractions dot-accessible on every DVCS/DVMP event, which is exactly the confusion Convention 1 of the roadmap targets.

summary: The new file sits in the roadmap-mandated `DIS/Diffractive/` directory but declares all of its contents in the `DIS.Exclusive.Kinematics.ExclKinematics` namespace, so roadmap-specific diffractive variables are added to the generic exclusive-kinematics API from a different directory — the only namespace/path divergence in `DIS/`. Imports are fine.
